name: Shanghai Yanpu Metal Products Co.,Ltd
summary: Shanghai Yanpu Metal Products Co.,Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of automotive seat parts in China. The company offers seat, skylight, engine, and lock stamping parts; seat assembly parts; and window regulatory stamping parts. The company also engages in assembly and welding; stamping die design; metal stampings; provision of gold-plated parts; molds; and other related accessories. It exports its products. The company was founded in 1999 and is based in Shanghai, China.
